Title: Fix $extractOk unconditional overwrite in Setup-LlamaCpp.ps1
Description: In native mode, $extractOk is set to $false inside the download-failure catch block, but is then unconditionally set to $true after the if (Test-Path $zipPath) block, overwriting the failure state. The extraction-failure path never propagates correctly. Fix: only set $extractOk = $true inside the success path, not after the conditional block.
